$comment: Model weights for the GPU images, pinned by SHA-256 (docs/13-licenses.md -> Models). Modal downloads each group while it builds that function's image and fails the build on any mismatch (weights.py). Only approved models belong here. `hashFrom` says where the hash was read; the image build is what proves it.
